context: DVWA low csrf: password change form has no user_token/anti-CSRF token, submitted via GET; only session cookie required, so external page can forge via or iframe
principle: No anti-CSRF token + GET state-changing request: cross-site forgery works with victim cookie only

context: DVWA CSRF medium：改密接口 GET /vulnerabilities/csrf/?password_new=X&password_conf=X&Change=Change，无任何 CSRF token。medium 仅校验 Referer：stripos($_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER'], $_SERVER['SERVER_NAME'])（source/medium.php line 5），SERVER_NAME=localhost。直接无 Referer 访问返回 'That request didn't look correct.'；用包含 'localhost' 的跨源 Referer 即绕过，密码被改成 evilpass1 并成功登录验证。
principle: 无 token，唯一防护是 Referer 子串匹配 SERVER_NAME；攻击者页面 URL 路径含 'localhost'（如 http://evil.example.com/localhost/csrf.html）使 Referer 命中 stripos 即绕过，实现跨站改密
